meta.title: One bid: award all 10 units to Vendor A; approver approves without a remark
gaps: The prepared state is closed with two bids, so the exact closed RFQ containing only Vendor A cannot be selected or verified; the resulting awarded-vendor counter cannot be asserted as 1/1.
Signing in as a separate approver user and approving from that user's session cannot be performed; approval is attempted only in the current pending-approver session.

plan.title: SRC-AWD-003 — Award Vendor A and Reject Blank Approval Remark

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS, as required for prepared-state cases.
Verify the prepared state exposes the two real bidding vendors, documenting why the one-bid premise is not exact.
Confirm Vendor A's offered quantity is the API-held 10 units.
Confirm Vendor A's bid rate is the API-held 100.
Verify Vendor A's amount and total arithmetic, including 10 × 100 = 1,000.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 units on the only line to Vendor A.
Assert that the line and proposal value reflect the full Vendor A allocation; the vendor counter is 1/2 because the prepared state has two bids.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Fill mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the completed proposal for approval.
Confirm the proposal is pending approval after submission.
Attempt approval with no remark to exercise the required-remark refusal.
Verify Procol refuses approval because the remark is empty.
Confirm the proposal remains pending after the refused approval.
